title: Feather Bold / Usage
slide_intent: Set boundaries for expressive type because a distinctive voice still needs readable rhythm and scale.
strategic_value: Controlled headline length, spacing and case can let Duolingo’s display face remain clear as well as recognizable.
demonstration: Three examples show a short headline, a phrase containing the wordmark and a left-aligned list, beside size, spacing, length and case guidance.
practical_value: Check headline length, size, leading, case and alignment before applying Feather Bold.

content_islands.name: Usage examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the short headline, brand-name phrase and left-aligned list with their role captions in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Setting rules
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and numerical settings, length, case, alignment and hyphenation conditions in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples demonstrate brief headlines, brand-name phrases and left-aligned lists.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text specifies 100–110% leading, -20 tracking, its printed “0, optical” kerning instruction, minimum 30 pt/px and case/alignment restrictions with exceptions.

ingredient.name: Feather Bold settings
ingredient.role: Maintain a readable expressive headline voice.
ingredient.application: Use 100–110% leading, tracking -20 and the source’s “0, optical” kerning instruction; never below 30 pt in print or 30 px onscreen. Use lowercase, with capitals allowed for person/place names; prefer left alignment, never fully justify or hyphenate. Longer than 10 words is a cue to consider DIN Next Rounded.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical display-face guidance. Above 80 pt in print or 80 px onscreen, leading may decrease as size increases; the source’s wording about long sentences is advisory.
